golden-gate-bridge-sunset.jpg.title: Big Red at Blue Hour — Golden Gate Bridge
golden-gate-bridge-sunset.jpg.description: The Golden Gate catches the last warm light as fog gathers over the bay, its towers glowing against a pastel San Francisco sky.
golden-gate-bridge-sunset.jpg.alt: The Golden Gate Bridge's red towers spanning the bay at sunset, San Francisco's skyline in the distance.

colosseum-rome-dusk.jpg.title: Two Thousand Years and Still Standing — The Colosseum
colosseum-rome-dusk.jpg.description: Rome's Colosseum stands floodlit against a violet dusk — nearly two thousand years of stone still commanding the skyline.
colosseum-rome-dusk.jpg.alt: The Colosseum in Rome glowing amber at dusk, birds flying overhead against a purple sky.

vatican-staircase-skylight-bw.jpg.title: Look Up — Vatican Skylight
vatican-staircase-skylight-bw.jpg.description: Looking straight up into the geometry of a Vatican skylight, concentric arches and glass resolving into a perfect octagon.
vatican-staircase-skylight-bw.jpg.alt: Looking straight up into an octagonal glass skylight above a spiral staircase, in black and white.

st-peters-basilica-vatican.jpg.title: Holding Court — St. Peter's Basilica
st-peters-basilica-vatican.jpg.description: Evening light warms the facade of St. Peter's Basilica, the empty square lending the grand architecture a rare stillness.
st-peters-basilica-vatican.jpg.alt: St. Peter's Basilica facade lit up in the evening, an empty square in front.

florence-skyline-sunset.jpg.title: Cotton Candy Skies — Florence
florence-skyline-sunset.jpg.description: Cotton-candy light settles over Florence, Brunelleschi's dome and the Palazzo Vecchio rising above the terracotta rooftops.
florence-skyline-sunset.jpg.alt: Florence's skyline at sunset, the Duomo's dome and bell tower rising above terracotta rooftops under a pink sky.

sailboat-marina-dusk.jpg.title: Masts and Mirrors — Marina at Dusk
sailboat-marina-dusk.jpg.description: Masts stand mirror-still over a glassy harbor at blue hour, dock lights bleeding gold into the water.
sailboat-marina-dusk.jpg.alt: Sailboats and their masts reflected in still water at a marina during blue hour.

antelope-canyon-stairway.jpg.title: Waves of Stone — Antelope Canyon
antelope-canyon-stairway.jpg.description: Deep inside Antelope Canyon, a lone figure on the stairway gives scale to the sculpted sandstone and a falling shaft of light.
antelope-canyon-stairway.jpg.alt: A visitor descending a metal stairway deep inside the glowing swirled walls of Antelope Canyon.

seattle-skyline-night-bw.jpg.title: Sleepless in Monochrome — Seattle Skyline
seattle-skyline-night-bw.jpg.description: Seattle's skyline glitters across the water in monochrome, the Space Needle anchoring a long, quiet night exposure.
seattle-skyline-night-bw.jpg.alt: The Seattle skyline, including the Space Needle, lit up at night in a black-and-white panorama.

yosemite-valley-star-trails.jpg.title: The Sky Left Streaks — Yosemite Star Trails
yosemite-valley-star-trails.jpg.description: Stars wheel over Yosemite Valley in long streaks while the last autumn color clings to the trees below the granite walls.
yosemite-valley-star-trails.jpg.alt: Circular star trails over Yosemite Valley, El Capitan and Half Dome silhouetted below.

delicate-arch-golden-hour.jpg.title: Golden Hour, Golden Arch — Delicate Arch
delicate-arch-golden-hour.jpg.description: Delicate Arch glows at golden hour, framed by the snow-dusted La Sal Mountains on the horizon.
delicate-arch-golden-hour.jpg.alt: Delicate Arch glowing gold in late-afternoon light, snow-capped mountains in the distance.

antelope-canyon-blue-sky.jpg.title: A Sliver of Sky — Antelope Canyon
antelope-canyon-blue-sky.jpg.description: A narrow ribbon of blue sky threads between the flame-colored walls of Antelope Canyon.
antelope-canyon-blue-sky.jpg.alt: A narrow slot of blue sky visible between towering magenta and orange sandstone canyon walls.

antelope-canyon-opening.jpg.title: Light at the End — Antelope Canyon
antelope-canyon-opening.jpg.description: Light spills through a canyon opening, igniting the layered sandstone in shades of amber and rust.
antelope-canyon-opening.jpg.alt: Light beaming through a canyon opening, illuminating layered amber and rust-colored sandstone.

marina-bay-sands-night.jpg.title: The Ship That Docked on Rooftops — Marina Bay Sands
marina-bay-sands-night.jpg.description: Marina Bay Sands hovers over the water like a ship run aground on rooftops, Singapore glowing beneath it.
marina-bay-sands-night.jpg.alt: Marina Bay Sands hotel and its rooftop illuminated blue at night, reflected in the water.

singapore-skyline-night.jpg.title: The City That Never Dims — Singapore Skyline
singapore-skyline-night.jpg.description: Singapore's financial district blazes across the bay, its towers doubled in the still night water.
singapore-skyline-night.jpg.alt: Singapore's illuminated skyline and a lit bridge reflected in the water at night.

half-dome-sunset-glacier-point.jpg.title: Last Light on the Giant — Half Dome
half-dome-sunset-glacier-point.jpg.description: Alpenglow sets Half Dome alight as seen from Glacier Point, the last fire of sunset spreading across the high country.
half-dome-sunset-glacier-point.jpg.alt: Half Dome glowing pink at sunset, seen from Glacier Point in Yosemite.

antelope-canyon-abstract.jpg.title: Sandstone in Motion — Antelope Canyon
antelope-canyon-abstract.jpg.description: The sandstone of Antelope Canyon dissolves into pure abstraction — waves of orange and violet carved by water and time.
antelope-canyon-abstract.jpg.alt: Swirling orange and purple sandstone walls in Antelope Canyon, forming abstract wave-like rock patterns.

snowy-mountain-forest.jpg.title: Fresh Powder, No Footprints — Snowy Forest
snowy-mountain-forest.jpg.description: Fresh snow blankets a pine forest, the mountains beyond fading into a soft winter overcast.
snowy-mountain-forest.jpg.alt: A snow-covered pine forest under a partly cloudy mountain sky.

autumn-maple-road.jpg.title: The Road Turns Red — Autumn Maples
autumn-maple-road.jpg.description: A quiet road curves beneath a corridor of maples at the peak of autumn, the asphalt strewn with fallen red leaves.
autumn-maple-road.jpg.alt: A residential street lined with bright red maple trees, fallen leaves covering the road and sidewalk.

boulder-flatirons-winter-bw.jpg.title: Snow Day Beneath the Flatirons — Boulder
boulder-flatirons-winter-bw.jpg.description: Snow settles over a building beneath Boulder's Flatirons, the range dissolving into cloud in this quiet monochrome.
boulder-flatirons-winter-bw.jpg.alt: A stone building dusted with snow beneath the Flatirons mountains, in black and white.

gerenuk-portrait.jpg.title: The Long-Necked One — Gerenuk
gerenuk-portrait.jpg.description: A gerenuk turns its slender neck toward the light, the antelope’s delicate features emerging from deep shadow.
gerenuk-portrait.jpg.alt: A gerenuk antelope's slender neck and face, ears alert, against a dark background.

los-angeles-skyline-night-bw.jpg.title: City of Angels After Dark — Los Angeles
los-angeles-skyline-night-bw.jpg.description: The lights of downtown Los Angeles stretch to the horizon in a sweeping black-and-white night panorama.
los-angeles-skyline-night-bw.jpg.alt: The Los Angeles skyline lit up at night, wide panoramic view in black and white.

sea-nettle-jellyfish.jpg.title: Grace on the Drift — Sea Nettle
sea-nettle-jellyfish.jpg.description: A sea nettle drifts through deep blue water, trailing lace-like tentacles behind its glowing bell.
sea-nettle-jellyfish.jpg.alt: A sea nettle jellyfish with long trailing tentacles drifting in dark blue water.

jellyfish-blue-water.jpg.title: Floating in the Deep Blue — Jellyfish
jellyfish-blue-water.jpg.description: Suspended in electric blue, a jellyfish pulses gently through the dark, backlit like stained glass.
jellyfish-blue-water.jpg.alt: A translucent jellyfish with a red-striped bell drifting through deep blue water.

jellyfish-glowing.jpg.title: Lit From Within — Jellyfish
jellyfish-glowing.jpg.description: A jellyfish glows from within against a field of cobalt, its striped bell impossibly delicate.
jellyfish-glowing.jpg.alt: A jellyfish glowing white and orange against a deep blue background, tentacles flowing above it.

jellyfish-drifting.jpg.title: Going With the Flow — Jellyfish
jellyfish-drifting.jpg.description: Tentacles streaming, a jellyfish drifts weightless through the aquarium’s blue dark.
jellyfish-drifting.jpg.alt: A jellyfish's tentacles trailing upward as it drifts through vivid blue water.

full-moon.jpg.title: Say Cheese, Moon — Full Moon
full-moon.jpg.description: The full moon hangs in a black sky, every crater and mare rendered in crisp monochrome detail.
full-moon.jpg.alt: A close-up of the full moon, showing its cratered surface against a black sky.

pfeiffer-beach-arch-sunset.jpg.title: Purple Sand, Golden Rock — Pfeiffer Beach
pfeiffer-beach-arch-sunset.jpg.description: Waves rush around the keyhole rock at Pfeiffer Beach while sunset paints the sky and its famous purple sand in soft pinks.
pfeiffer-beach-arch-sunset.jpg.alt: A sea arch at Pfeiffer Beach glowing gold at sunset, waves washing onto purple sand.

yosemite-falls.jpg.title: The Long Drop — Yosemite Falls
yosemite-falls.jpg.description: Yosemite Falls tumbles down the granite in a long white ribbon, framed by green summer forest.
yosemite-falls.jpg.alt: Yosemite Falls cascading down a granite cliff face, green trees in the foreground.

dream-lake-stargazing-night.jpg.title: Just Me and a Billion Stars — Dream Lake
dream-lake-stargazing-night.jpg.description: A lone stargazer sits beneath a sky full of stars at Dream Lake, Hallett Peak looming over the still water.
dream-lake-stargazing-night.jpg.alt: A person sitting on rocks beside Dream Lake, gazing up at a star-filled, aurora-tinted sky.

delicate-arch-sunburst.jpg.title: Catching the Sun — Delicate Arch
delicate-arch-sunburst.jpg.description: The midday sun bursts over Delicate Arch, flaring across the red-rock bowl of Arches National Park.
delicate-arch-sunburst.jpg.alt: Delicate Arch with the sun peeking above the horizon, lens flare and desert mesas beyond.

delicate-arch-backlit-sunstar.jpg.title: Backlit and Blazing — Delicate Arch
delicate-arch-backlit-sunstar.jpg.description: Backlit by a low sun, Delicate Arch becomes a silhouette while a sharp sunstar bursts along its edge.
delicate-arch-backlit-sunstar.jpg.alt: Delicate Arch silhouetted against a bright sunburst breaking through the blue sky.

delicate-arch-la-sal-mountains.jpg.title: Framing the La Sals — Delicate Arch
delicate-arch-la-sal-mountains.jpg.description: Delicate Arch frames the snow-capped La Sal Mountains, red sandstone meeting distant white peaks.
delicate-arch-la-sal-mountains.jpg.alt: Delicate Arch framed against the snow-covered La Sal Mountains under a pale sky.

delicate-arch-sunset.jpg.title: Nature's Doorway at Golden Hour — Delicate Arch
delicate-arch-sunset.jpg.description: Warm sunset light pours through Delicate Arch, the sandstone glowing above the desert and distant mountains.
delicate-arch-sunset.jpg.alt: Delicate Arch glowing orange at sunset, snow-capped mountains and desert layers behind it.

mesa-arch-canyonlands.jpg.title: A Window on Canyon Country — Mesa Arch
mesa-arch-canyonlands.jpg.description: Mesa Arch frames a vast expanse of canyon country, its underside lit by reflected morning light.
mesa-arch-canyonlands.jpg.alt: Mesa Arch framing a distant canyon view in Canyonlands National Park under a cloudy sky.

canyonlands-overlook-panorama.jpg.title: As Far as the Eye Can See — Canyonlands
canyonlands-overlook-panorama.jpg.description: A sweeping panorama over Canyonlands, endless mesas and carved washes receding to the horizon.
canyonlands-overlook-panorama.jpg.alt: A sweeping panorama of red rock mesas and canyons stretching to the horizon at Canyonlands.

elk-bw.jpg.title: Young and Watchful — Elk
elk-bw.jpg.description: A young elk pauses at the forest edge, its portrait rendered in soft black and white.
elk-bw.jpg.alt: A young elk with small antlers looking back over its shoulder in a grassy field, in black and white.

stellers-jay.jpg.title: Bad Hair, Don't Care — Steller's Jay
stellers-jay.jpg.description: A Steller’s jay shows off its crest and electric-blue plumage against a muted forest floor.
stellers-jay.jpg.alt: A Steller's jay with a tall black crest and blue body, standing on the forest floor.

grand-teton-milky-way-panorama.jpg.title: The Galaxy Over the Tetons — Milky Way
grand-teton-milky-way-panorama.jpg.description: The Milky Way arcs over the jagged Teton range in a wide night panorama above the sagebrush flats.
grand-teton-milky-way-panorama.jpg.alt: The Milky Way arching over the jagged peaks of the Grand Tetons at night.

suv-under-the-stars.jpg.title: Parked Beneath the Cosmos — Road Trip
suv-under-the-stars.jpg.description: A car rests beneath a sky thick with stars, mountains lining the horizon on a quiet road-trip night.
suv-under-the-stars.jpg.alt: An SUV parked on a road beneath a star-filled sky with the Milky Way visible.

moose-portrait.jpg.title: The Gentle Giant — Moose
moose-portrait.jpg.description: A young moose emerges from the dark timber, ears forward, caught in a shaft of forest light.
moose-portrait.jpg.alt: A moose's head and shoulders in profile against a dark forest background.

grizzly-bear-brush.jpg.title: Just Bearly Hidden — Grizzly
grizzly-bear-brush.jpg.description: A grizzly moves through a hillside of green brush, glancing back toward the camera.
grizzly-bear-brush.jpg.alt: A grizzly bear walking through green brush and wildflowers on a hillside.

grand-teton-sunset.jpg.title: The Sky Caught Fire — Grand Teton
grand-teton-sunset.jpg.description: The sky catches fire above the Grand Tetons, burning cloud framing the snow-streaked peaks.
grand-teton-sunset.jpg.alt: The Grand Teton mountain range silhouetted beneath a fiery orange and pink sunset sky.

grizzly-bear-bw.jpg.title: Fresh Out of the Water — Grizzly
grizzly-bear-bw.jpg.description: A grizzly lifts its head streaming with water, droplets frozen against the dark in stark black and white.
grizzly-bear-bw.jpg.alt: A wet grizzly bear shaking off water, close-up profile, in black and white.

ground-squirrel-bw.jpg.title: Do Not Disturb — Ground Squirrel
ground-squirrel-bw.jpg.description: A ground squirrel curls up for a nap among the rocks — a small, quiet moment in monochrome.
ground-squirrel-bw.jpg.alt: A ground squirrel curled up asleep among rocks, in black and white.

gray-wolf-resting-bw.jpg.title: Keeping One Eye Open — Gray Wolf
gray-wolf-resting-bw.jpg.description: A gray wolf rests in the grass, one eye open and watchful, in a quiet black-and-white study.
gray-wolf-resting-bw.jpg.alt: A gray wolf resting on the ground with alert eyes open, in black and white.

wolf-howling-bw.jpg.title: Someone Order a Solo? — Howling Wolf
wolf-howling-bw.jpg.description: A wolf lifts its muzzle to howl, rim-lit against a black forest in dramatic monochrome.
wolf-howling-bw.jpg.alt: A wolf standing in profile, howling with its head tilted back, in black and white.

wolf-eye-closeup.jpg.title: Here's Looking at You — Gray Wolf
wolf-eye-closeup.jpg.description: A single amber eye burns out of a wolf’s gray face, the rest of the frame drained to black and white.
wolf-eye-closeup.jpg.alt: Extreme close-up of a gray wolf's amber eye and surrounding fur, in black and white with the eye in natural color.

wolf-eyes-closeup.jpg.title: Windows to the Wild — Wolf Eyes
wolf-eyes-closeup.jpg.description: The unblinking amber eyes of a wolf hold the frame, every hair rendered sharp against soft shadow.
wolf-eyes-closeup.jpg.alt: Close-up of a wolf's face, focusing on both amber eyes, in black and white.

two-wolves-in-grass.jpg.title: Partners in Crime — Wolf Pair
two-wolves-in-grass.jpg.description: Two wolves move together through spring grass, one snarling playfully at the other.
two-wolves-in-grass.jpg.alt: Two gray wolves standing together in tall grass near pine branches.

two-wolves-walking.jpg.title: The Morning Patrol — Wolf Pair
two-wolves-walking.jpg.description: A pair of wolves stride toward the camera in step — the morning patrol of the pack.
two-wolves-walking.jpg.alt: Two gray wolves walking side by side across a grassy field.

bald-eagle-pair.jpg.title: Two Birds, One Camera — Bald Eagles
bald-eagle-pair.jpg.description: Two bald eagles lean close against the dark rock, one staring straight down the lens.
bald-eagle-pair.jpg.alt: Two bald eagles perched close together against dark rocks, one facing forward and one in profile.

rainbow-trout-portrait.jpg.title: Scales Like Stained Glass — Rainbow Trout
rainbow-trout-portrait.jpg.description: A rainbow trout’s head fills the frame, its scales shimmering like wet stained glass.
rainbow-trout-portrait.jpg.alt: Close-up of a rainbow trout's head, showing its iridescent pink and green scales.

bison-grazing.jpg.title: Lawn Care, Yellowstone Edition — Bison
bison-grazing.jpg.description: A bison lowers its massive head to graze, backlit fur catching the light in Yellowstone’s meadows.
bison-grazing.jpg.alt: Close-up of a bison grazing on grass, showing its head, horn, and shaggy fur.

grand-prismatic-spring-panorama.jpg.title: Earth's Own Rainbow — Grand Prismatic Spring
grand-prismatic-spring-panorama.jpg.description: Yellowstone’s Grand Prismatic Spring blooms in impossible color, rings of orange and blue radiating from its steaming center.
grand-prismatic-spring-panorama.jpg.alt: Aerial panorama of Grand Prismatic Spring, showing its rainbow-colored mineral rings.

aurora-over-neighborhood.jpg.title: The Sky Put On a Show — Aurora
aurora-over-neighborhood.jpg.description: A rare aurora ripples pink and green over a Colorado neighborhood, the night sky briefly turned electric.
aurora-over-neighborhood.jpg.alt: Purple and green aurora borealis lighting up the night sky above a suburban neighborhood.

aurora-borealis-colorado.jpg.title: Northern Lights, Down South — Aurora over Colorado
aurora-borealis-colorado.jpg.description: The northern lights blaze crimson and green far south of their usual range, glowing over rooftops in Colorado.
aurora-borealis-colorado.jpg.alt: Vivid pink and green aurora borealis glowing over a row of houses under a starry sky.

gray-wolf-walking-bw.jpg.title: On the Prowl — Gray Wolf
gray-wolf-walking-bw.jpg.description: A gray wolf pads through shadow, head low and eyes fixed, in moody black and white.
gray-wolf-walking-bw.jpg.alt: A gray wolf walking forward through shadowed brush, in black and white.

wolf-snarling.jpg.title: Not in the Mood — Snarling Wolf
wolf-snarling.jpg.description: A wolf curls its lip in a snarl, a single amber eye and pink tongue breaking through the monochrome.
wolf-snarling.jpg.alt: A wolf snarling with bared teeth, close-up profile in black and white with an amber eye.

white-wolf-portrait.jpg.title: Eyes of Amber — White Wolf
white-wolf-portrait.jpg.description: A white wolf meets the camera with calm amber eyes, its pale fur glowing against the dark.
white-wolf-portrait.jpg.alt: A close-up portrait of a white wolf with amber eyes, in black and white.

wolf-baring-teeth.jpg.title: All Teeth, No Bluff — Wolf
wolf-baring-teeth.jpg.description: A wolf bares its teeth in warning, the flash of fang and tongue set against silver-gray fur.
wolf-baring-teeth.jpg.alt: A wolf baring its teeth, close-up of its snarling face in black and white with amber eyes.

wolf-portrait-bw.jpg.title: The Quiet Stare — Wolf
wolf-portrait-bw.jpg.description: A wolf holds a quiet, steady gaze, its portrait soft and grainy in black and white.
wolf-portrait-bw.jpg.alt: A wolf walking toward the camera with a direct gaze, in black and white.

wolf-in-snowfall.jpg.title: First Snow of the Season — Wolf
wolf-in-snowfall.jpg.description: A wolf watches through falling snow, flakes catching in its thick winter coat.
wolf-in-snowfall.jpg.alt: A wolf's face in falling snow, ears perked, in black and white.

mountain-forest-waterfall.jpg.title: Where the Mountain Spills Over — Waterfall
mountain-forest-waterfall.jpg.description: A mountain stream spills over granite steps through evergreen forest, water blurred to silk by a long exposure.
mountain-forest-waterfall.jpg.alt: A waterfall cascading over boulders through a pine forest in the mountains.

pelican-in-flight.jpg.title: Riding the Golden Light — Pelican
pelican-in-flight.jpg.description: A pelican banks through warm, hazy light, wings spread wide against a glowing sky.
pelican-in-flight.jpg.alt: A pelican in flight with wings fully spread, backlit by golden light.

bison-herd-grazing-bw.jpg.title: Grazing Committee Meeting — Bison Herd
bison-herd-grazing-bw.jpg.description: A bison lowers its head to graze while the rest of the herd trails behind across a quiet, frost-touched field.
bison-herd-grazing-bw.jpg.alt: A bison grazing with its head down, more bison visible walking behind it in a field, in black and white.

black-bear-cubs-mountainside.jpg.title: Mom's Got Backup — Black Bear & Cubs
black-bear-cubs-mountainside.jpg.description: A black bear leads her two cinnamon-colored cubs across a rocky mountainside, single file and watchful.
black-bear-cubs-mountainside.jpg.alt: A black bear walking across a rocky mountainside followed by two cinnamon-colored cubs.

grand-teton-reflection-sunset.jpg.title: Double Take — Grand Teton Reflection
grand-teton-reflection-sunset.jpg.description: The Tetons and a blazing sunset sky mirror perfectly in the still water of a beaver pond.
grand-teton-reflection-sunset.jpg.alt: Grand Teton mountains under a fiery sunset sky, perfectly reflected in a calm pond.

alpine-ridge-storm-bw.jpg.title: Weather's Rolling In — Alpine Ridge
alpine-ridge-storm-bw.jpg.description: A snow-dusted alpine ridge disappears into storm clouds, rendered in stark black and white.
alpine-ridge-storm-bw.jpg.alt: A rugged, snow-dusted mountain ridge beneath heavy storm clouds, in black and white.
